zh.title: 漢光演習第3天 第一作戰區動員無人機與戰車演練
zh.summary: 「漢光42號」演習於2026年8月7日進入第3天，第一作戰區於澎湖進行應援作戰演練。演習模擬敵特工襲擾海軍港口彈藥庫，軍方升空監偵型無人機提供即時影像，並結合M60A3戰車與海軍陸戰隊兵力實施圍捕封控，完成重要設施防衛任務。
body: 台灣國軍「漢光42號」實兵演習於2026年8月7日進入第3天，第一作戰區於澎湖縣實施應援作戰演練。演習模擬敵方特工人員襲擾海軍軍區內的港口彈藥庫，國軍隨即啟動整合無人機與M60A3戰車等兵力進行防衛應處。
演練期間，監偵型無人機率先升空傳輸即時畫面，協助指揮官掌握敵情與規劃部署。M60A3戰車依據情資調整火力配置，封控彈藥庫周邊；海軍陸戰隊官兵則向目標搜捕並壓制模擬敵軍，完成軍事設施防護任務。
根據國軍先前公布資訊，「漢光42號」實兵演習自2026年8月5日展開，預計持續進行至8月14日。

en.title: Taiwan Drill Integrates Drones and M60A3 Tanks for Base Defense
en.summary: On August 7, 2026, during the third day of Taiwan's Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise, the First Operational Zone conducted a support operation drill in Penghu County. The exercise simulated an enemy commando attack on a naval port ammunition depot, utilizing reconnaissance drones to stream real-time video imagery for command situational awareness. Integrated M60A3 tanks and Marine Corps personnel subsequently established crossfire positioning to encircle simulated hostile forces and protect key military infrastructure.
body: On August 7, 2026, the third day of Taiwan's Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise, the First Operational Zone conducted a support operation drill in Penghu County. The drill simulated enemy commando forces raiding a port ammunition depot inside a navy base, prompting defensive responses using reconnaissance unmanned aerial vehicles and M60A3 tanks.

Reconnaissance UAVs launched first to transmit real-time video feeds to commanders for battlefield situational awareness and movement planning. M60A3 tanks adjusted positioning to establish crossfire around the depot, while Marine Corps personnel advanced to suppress simulated hostile forces and secure the facility.
According to military information, the Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise commenced on August 5, 2026, and is scheduled to continue through August 14.
